correctness.rationale: The coordinate forms are quartics with no common factor. Homogeneity gives \(C'=C^3Z^2\) and \(D'=C^4Z^4D\), so the second iterate is the identity projectively off \(CDZ=0\). The reduced base locus follows exhaustively from \(D=0\) plus coprimality. Direct symbolic differentiation gives \(\det(J)=4Z^2C^3D\), proving the seven exceptional plane components and excluding further exceptional hypersurfaces. The attached generic-coefficient SymPy replay checks the composition and Jacobian identities exactly.

This explains concretely how the Nikulin automorphism of the K3 model sits inside the Cremona group of \(\mathbf P^3\) and supplies geometric data needed to resolve or compare the ambient transformation.
